answer.goRequestWebsiteDashboard: Go to "Request website" in your dashboard. Fill out the form with your business details and what you need. Our team will review your request and contact you about next steps.
answer.youllNeedBusinessName: You'll need your business name, description, contact information, and any branding materials (logo, colors) you have. The more details you provide about your vision, the better we can match your expectations.
answer.wellGiveTimelineAfter: We'll give you a timeline after we review your request. The process includes the first design, your revisions, and launch. Most of the time depends on how quickly we get your details and approvals. We'll keep you updated along the way.
answer.yesCancelAnyTime: Yes, you can cancel at any time. Choose Cancel options in your dashboard. Your website stays online until the end of your paid period. If you want to keep your website, you can buy your website files. See the buyout prices in the FAQ.
answer.closeRequestFromRequest: You can close a request from the request page (Dashboard, then View or update). If you have an active hosting plan, you'll need to cancel the plan first, because your site is still hosted under it and we don't want you charged for a request that's closed. To cancel your plan, choose Cancel options in your dashboard. Your plan stays active until the end of the current billing period. Once it has ended, you can close the request. Closing a request never cancels a plan on its own.
answer.yesEverySiteBuild: Yes. Every site we build works on phones, tablets and computers, and we check it on each before launch.
answer.everySiteIncludesBasics: Every site includes the basics that help search engines read it: a page title and description for each page, clean page structure, and a mobile-friendly layout. We can't promise any search ranking.
answer.signPageClickForgot: On the sign-in page, click "Forgot password?" and enter your email. We'll email you a link to set a new password. No email after a few minutes? Check your spam folder, or email support@freeplug-in.dev. If you sign in with Google, use "Continue with Google" instead.
answer.contactSupportSupportFreeplug: Contact support at support@freeplug-in.dev to request an email change. We'll confirm it's you, then update your account and let you know.
answer.emailSupportFreeplugDev: Email support@freeplug-in.dev with your account deletion request. We'll delete it and email you when it's done. This can't be undone.

answer.freeplugReachesLocalBusiness: Freeplug helps local businesses, small agencies, apps, creators, freelancers and one-product stores get a website, and 72 After builds it for free. We're currently reaching out to businesses in San Marcos, New Braunfels, Kyle, Buda, Seguin, Lockhart, San Antonio, Austin, Wimberley and Dripping Springs, Texas. We plan to expand across Texas soon and, if possible, throughout the U.S.
answer.yesWebsiteDevelopmentFree: Yes. Website development is free. 72 After designs and builds your website at no charge. After your site is live, you pay for monthly hosting, which is required. Maintenance or a buyout costs extra only if you ask for it. There are no hidden fees or surprise charges.
answer.hostingRequiredKeepWebsite: Hosting is required to keep your website online. You can cancel any time. Your website stays online until your paid period ends, then goes offline. If you sign up for hosting again, we bring it back.
answer.everySiteDifferentSo: Every site is different, so we'll give you a timeline after we review your request. Most of the time depends on how quickly we get your business details and approvals. We'll keep you updated along the way.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what information Freeplug collects, why we collect it, and the choices you have. We wrote it in plain English. If anything is unclear, email us at <email>support@freeplug-in.dev</email>.

whoWeAre.p1: Freeplug is a service of 72 After, based in Central Texas, United States. We build and host websites for small businesses, creators and freelancers, mainly in Texas and the rest of the United States. In this policy, "we" and "us" mean Freeplug and 72 After.

whatWeCollect.p1: Account information: your email address and a password when you create an account, or your name and email address from Google if you choose to sign in with Google.
whatWeCollect.p2: Website request and consultation details: your business name, contact phone number, your Google Business Profile link if you share it, notes, and your answers about pages, look, content, domain and plan.
whatWeCollect.p3: Business details for your site: things like your phone number, address, hours, service area, services, a quote email address, and photos you upload. Before we reach out to a business, we may gather this kind of information from public business listings to build a draft site, and the owner can confirm, change or remove it.
whatWeCollect.p4: Payment information: when you pay, our payment processor collects your card details and billing information. We never see or store your full card number. We keep a record of your plan, payments and buyout progress.
whatWeCollect.p5: Messages: emails and change requests you send us, and emails we send you about your account and site.
whatWeCollect.p6: Technical information: basic request data that every website receives, such as IP address, browser type and the pages you open. We use it for security, spam protection and fixing problems.

howWeUse.p1: To build, host and update your website; to run your account, billing and buyout; to send you account, service and billing emails; to answer your questions; to keep the site secure and block spam and abuse; and to meet legal and tax obligations.
howWeUse.p2: Business outreach emails include a way to unsubscribe, and we honor it.

howWeShare.p1: We do not sell your personal information, and we do not share it for advertising.
howWeShare.p2: We share information only with service providers that help us run Freeplug, and only what they need to do their job: a website hosting and security provider, a database and sign-in provider, a payment processor, an email delivery provider, a spam and bot protection service, a scheduling provider (if you book a live session), and Google, if you choose to sign in with Google.
howWeShare.p3: We may also share information if the law requires it, to protect our rights or users' safety, or as part of a sale or merger of our business.

cookies.p1: We use a small number of cookies that the site needs to work: sign-in cookies that keep you logged in, short-lived security cookies for password resets and site previews, and a language cookie that remembers whether you chose English or Spanish.
cookies.p2: Our spam and bot protection check may use its own cookies or similar technology to tell people from bots.
cookies.p3: We do not use advertising cookies or third-party analytics trackers.

retention.p1: We keep account and website information for as long as your account is active or we host your site, and for a reasonable time afterwards so you can come back. Payment and tax records are kept as long as the law requires. Security and spam-protection records are kept for a short time. You can ask us to delete your information sooner (see Your rights).

security.p1: We use encrypted connections (HTTPS), access controls, and signed, short-lived cookies, and we remove hidden location data from uploaded photos. No system is perfectly secure, but we work to protect your information and fix problems quickly.

yourRights.p1: You can ask to see the personal information we have about you, correct it, or delete it. Email <email>support@freeplug-in.dev</email> from the address on your account and tell us what you need. We will answer within a reasonable time. Deleting your account may take your website offline.

highRiskPii.p1: We don't build websites that collect high-risk personal information, such as medical or health records and patient intake (HIPAA), tax preparation and tax services, Social Security numbers or ID and passport scans, banking, lending, credit repair or insurance applications, storing card numbers directly, legal case intake, background checks, bail bonds, immigration, children's data (COPPA), dating, adult or therapy platforms, HR or employee-record portals, and government or voter data.
highRiskPii.p2: Taking card payments through a payment processor is fine: the processor handles the card details, and neither we nor your website store full card numbers.

ageRequirement.p1: Freeplug is only for adults 18 and older. We do not knowingly collect information from anyone under 18. If you believe someone under 18 has given us information, email us and we will delete it.

changes.p1: If we change this policy, we will update it on this page and change the date at the top. If a change is significant, we will let account holders know by email.

contact.p1: Freeplug (a 72 After service), Central Texas. Email: <email>support@freeplug-in.dev</email>.

buyout.faqAnswer: Yes. You can buy your website files for a one-time price based on how many pages your site has: 1 page $250, 2 pages $300, 3 pages $350, 4 pages $400, 5 pages $450, 6 to 7 pages $700, 8 to 11 pages $950, 12 to 15 pages $1,200, and 16 to 25 pages $2,000. 26+ pages?
